description: Create an agent in your workspace: a named ledger whose every event is ed25519-signed and hash-chained. `initial_credits` mints supply to the workspace issuer, not to the agent - fund_agent moves credits across when you need usage metering. Costs 1 unit. Authenticate with the workspace key in _meta[satledger/api-key].

api_key.description: Your workspace key, if your client cannot set _meta[satledger/api-key]. Prefer _meta: arguments are logged by most clients.

name: create_agent
title: Create an agent
